detail.longDescription: I submitted a Pull Request to update MacPorts' Got (Game of Trees) to the -portable 0.130 here: https://github.com/macports/macports-ports/pull/35701 It has been merged! I didn't finish my MacPorts' update to snac yet, because the Makefile patch broke and I've been scampering around all day with a rental car more or less putting all the vinyl I purchased from the Kishi Bashi, AMP Festival, and Denver Wax Trax into storage. I sincerely need to overhaul my storage unit with much better vinyl storage and that requires time and money, neither of which I seem to have in abundance, just the opposite. ;( I'll hopefully have more opportunity to fix the Makefile patch for MacPorts' snac tomorrow? I'm currently doing laundry (no more clean clothes and I did laundry while I was in Montreal too! I travel lightly, yet that means I don't have an enormous wardrobe either and due to attempting to air dry my clothes to maximize their longevity? I may be wearing the same outfit I am presently wearing for another day or two.) I'm exceedingly grateful that rueda posted a Got release announcement to undeadly.org at least! I was planning on that yet, clearly have been burning the candle at all ends as it were. #Got #GameOfTrees #MacPorts #OpenSource #VersionControl #Git
